0022600020.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-3, 10th in the East) visit the Miami Heat (1-4, 13th in the East) in Indiana's sixth game of the 2026-27 season, an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Ivica Zubac is a game-time decision with a day-to-day ankle sprain, while Miami's Simone Fontecchio is also a game-time decision with an illness. The teams have not met yet this season, but Indiana won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 135-118 victory in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
